critic.fix_suggestion: Modify the 'Upper-deck' primitive by increasing its length along the longitudinal axis by 40% to extend past the cockpit. Simultaneously, increase its vertical height by 25% and apply a fillet/bevel of 15 degrees to the front edge to smooth the transition from the nose. Finally, taper the rear face of the primitive at a 30-degree angle toward the fuselage to eliminate the abrupt vertical end.

discrepancies.observed: A short, stubby protrusion that ends very quickly behind the cockpit.
discrepancies.reference: An elongated upper deck that extends significantly further back along the fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase length of the upper deck primitive

discrepancies.observed: The top surface is relatively flat and low compared to the main fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: A more pronounced, rounded elevation above the main cabin line.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase vertical height of the upper deck geometry

discrepancies.observed: Sharp, angular transition from the nose to the top of the hump.
discrepancies.reference: Smooth, aerodynamic blending between the cockpit area and the upper deck.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: smooth/round the front edge of the upper deck primitive

discrepancies.observed: The hump ends abruptly with a vertical face.
discrepancies.reference: A gradual tapering back into the main fuselage structure.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: taper the rear end of the upper deck geometry
